tasks.message:
Reproduce and fix the original SDW-006/A21/E03 rejected-Apply UI recovery defect. setup.js catch currently treats explicit stale/context/auth errors as lost responses and retains a modal plan that disables refresh/project/session-check. Build exact existing-backend behavior evidence before changing classification. PLAN_STALE is distinct from ambiguous network/5xx, and403 is NOT automatically proof of no effect: API rechecks read authorization after the manager has applied, and an earlier response may have been lost. Preserve original request/plan/key until a genuinely authoritative receipt or definite nonexecution is established; never create duplicate effects or imply cancelling an already-issued operation. Audit Escape/Cancel/reload alongside recovery so a user can regain diagnostics/session and resolve an uncertain operation without silently losing its key. Re-auth/current-owner/project fences remain server-authoritative; no automatic Apply. Add meaningful behavior/browser regression tests for definite stale, expired auth, revoked permission, busy/context and lost/late response with exact key retention and no double effect. Cover keyboard focus/modal and narrow viewport if related defects appear. Use current API error contracts; change backend only if necessary for an unambiguous safe contract. For safe later installation, add only the exact wizard-only DeploymentBranch allowlist entry codex/sdw-qualified-ui-recovery-20261104 with default/origin/remoteSHA/owner checks unchanged and targeted allow/reject tests. Do not deploy or stop services in this implementation stage. Publish exact assigned result with honest real-vs-fixture evidence.
